label: Улыбаясь
description: A 10-sentence card for улыбаясь, the imperfective gerund of улыбаться.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Reflexive front position. Улыбаясь comes from the reflexive улыбаться (улыба-ются) plus the reflexive gerund ending -ясь. The fronted gerund names what she did while opening the door.
Strategic focus: End position. Here улыбаясь closes the sentence and runs parallel to отвечал. Both actions belong to the subject он and happen at the same moment.

Strategic focus: Reflexive ending -ясь. Reflexive verbs keep their reflexive marker in the gerund as -ясь, not plain -я. Улыбаясь runs simultaneously with the present main verb делаешь — smiling, you brighten the day.

missions.phrase: Улыбаясь, человек располагает к себе других.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Same-subject rule. The one who smiles in улыбаясь must be the one who wins others over — a single subject человек. A reflexive gerund still cannot introduce a separate doer.
Strategic focus: Future main clause. The main clause is future (встретим), but улыбаясь stays unchanged — gerunds have no future form. Smiling, we will greet the first visitors.
Strategic focus: Plural subject. Even with the plural subject дети, the reflexive form stays улыбаясь — gerunds are indeclinable and take no number ending, unlike the participle улыбающиеся.
Strategic focus: Past main clause. The finite verb вспоминала is past, yet улыбаясь marks concurrency: while smiling, she recalled her wedding. The imperfective gerund signals overlap, not sequence.

Strategic focus: Present habitual. The main verb предлагает is a general present, and улыбаясь gives the accompanying manner: smiling, the seller offers fresh bread. The reflexive gerund keeps its single -ясь form.

Strategic focus: Indeclinable form. With the feminine subject девочка the gerund stays улыбаясь, taking no gender or case ending. The participle улыбающаяся would inflect; the gerund holds one fixed shape.

missions.phrase: Улыбаясь друг другу, они шли молча.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Two parallel actions. Они is the shared subject of both шли and улыбаясь, the actions overlapping in time. The reflexive gerund folds while they smiled into one indeclinable word.
